extraction_text: Arjuna asks Krishna to explain the true meanings of renunciation (sannyasa) and abandonment (tyaga).

Krishna describes three types of abandonment based on the three gunas (qualities): tamasic (ignorant), rajasic (passionate), and sattvic (pure).

attributes.supernatural_elements: Concept of three gunas (qualities of nature)

extraction_text: Krishna states that sacrifice, charity, and austerity should not be abandoned but performed as they purify the wise.

Krishna describes Rajasic happiness that begins sweet but ends bitter, arising from sensory contact.
Krishna describes Tamasic happiness that deludes the self through sleep, laziness, and negligence.

Krishna teaches that success comes from performing one's own duty with devotion, even if imperfect.

Krishna instructs Arjuna on spiritual discipline and self-control.
Krishna explains achieving unity with Brahman through detachment and equanimity.
Krishna reveals that through devotion and understanding of Krishna, one attains eternal liberation.
